workflows.name: Identity workflow demo
workflows.inputs: Sanitized ServiceNow ticket and matching approval sample
workflows.outputs: Converted onboarding CSV and identity change packet

workflows.name: Onboarding batch
workflows.inputs: User CSV, approval record, optional password handoff key
workflows.outputs: Users, license assignments, group membership, run report
workflows.evidence: Run report, rollback artifact, change packet

workflows.name: Offboarding plan
workflows.inputs: User principal name or Jira-derived plan plus approval record
workflows.outputs: Disabled access, revoked sessions, removed groups/licenses

workflows.name: Baseline reporting
workflows.inputs: Tenant/report access or sanitized sample data
workflows.evidence: Generated reports, dashboard artifact, screenshot manifest for sample refreshes

workflows.name: Backup and restore
workflows.inputs: Source path, destination, retention, optional encryption key
workflows.outputs: ZIP or encrypted backup plus manifest
